input.instruction: Answer the customer’s policy question using the supplied records and handbook. Complete the requested fields and provide a concise explanation. This is an informational request; propose no account or claim actions.

data.text: Schedule your heirloom watch for a $6,000 item limit. Scheduling one jewelry item raises the limit for every necklace and earring you own.

data.note: This sample is not an endorsement on P-107.

messages.text: My own necklace and earrings were stolen together from my apartment on October 2. Their combined value is about $2,400.
A page about scheduling a watch for $6,000 is in the file. Should I apply that to your necklace and earrings?
Neither the necklace nor the earrings is scheduled. That watch ad is for a different item I do not have on this policy.
My declarations say $30,000 for belongings, so does that mean the theft limit for my jewelry is $30,000 too? If not, just tell me the applicable limit.
Would you like a payout calculation from the $2,400 estimate?
I do want to know what would be paid, but first only the applicable limit. Do not calculate a payout from that estimate, and do not treat the watch ad as my endorsement.

personal_property_limit.description: Issued total personal-property limit in USD.

jewelry_theft_sublimit.description: Applicable per-occurrence jewelry-theft sublimit in USD.

sublimit_additional_to_property_limit.description: Whether the jewelry sublimit is an additional amount above the total personal-property limit.

payment_estimate.description: Payment estimate in USD, or null when not requested or not supported.
